__NOEDITSECTION__ __NOTOC__
===Field list===
*image
*name
*birth
*birthplace
*residence
*gender
*pronouns
*height
*hair
*eyes
*occupation
*hobbies
*contribs
*userboxes (place optional userbox template here)

===Color modifiers===
*c1
*c2
*c3
*imageBG
*userboxBG

===Usage===
To use this template, paste the following code into the top of your userpage, filling all relevant fields:
<pre><nowiki>
{{UserInfobox
|c1=
|c2=
|c3=
|userboxBG=
|image=
|name=
|birth= 
|birthplace=
|residence=
|gender=
|pronouns=
|height= 
|hair= 
|eyes=
|occupation=
|hobbies=
|contribs=
|userboxes=
}}</nowiki></pre>

===Notes===
#All the data fields are collapsible, so do not worry about leaving any of them empty. 

==Example(s)==
{{UserInfobox
|c1=3366cc
|c2=99ccff
|c3=
|userboxBG=
|name=your name
|birth=your date of birth
|birthplace=your place of birth
|gender=your gender
|pronouns=any pronouns
|height=your height
|hair=your hair color
|eyes=your eye color
|hobbies=your hobbies
|contribs=notable contributions
|userboxes={{Lang|en|N}}
{{UserFirefox}}
{{UserSW|3}}
}}

===Code===
<pre><nowiki>
{{UserInfobox
|c1=3366cc
|c2=99ccff
|c3=
|userboxBG=
|name=your name
|birth=your date of birth
|birthplace=your place of birth
|gender=your gender
|pronouns=any pronouns
|height=your height
|hair=your hair color
|eyes=your eye color
|hobbies=your hobbies
|contribs=notable contributions
|userboxes={{Lang|en|N}}
{{UserFirefox}}
{{UserSW|3}}
}}</nowiki></pre>
